messages.subject: International Executive Profile | Industrial, ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Friisberg London Team,

Your international executive-search network and work across senior leadership markets align with my cross-border profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments across mining, energy, infrastructure and industrial sectors. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
